decisions.reason: The sewer cleaning box builds on the firm's fluid-handling and metal fabrication knowledge, enabling it to interpret early market feedback and improve the product.
Public waste bins leverage existing sheet-metal fabrication and surface-treatment skills and the firm's public-sector customer relationships.
The ground-sleeve line draws mainly on familiar steel fabrication and coating capabilities, allowing the firm to assimilate feedback and adjust designs.
Cast iron processing lies outside the firm's steel and stainless expertise, limiting its ability to learn from early results and improve the product.
Steel ground sleeves build directly on existing steel processing, welding, and surface-treatment knowledge, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity for this product.
